purpose: Determine whether the frozen long-term Adelie sites contain paired Landsat-7 ETM+ and Landsat-8 OLI Level-1 acquisitions suitable for an Antarctic-specific spectral bridge validation.

pairing.pair_assignment: deterministic greedy nearest-date pairing; each scene used at most once

interpretation: This is metadata support only; it does not validate a sensor bridge.
SLC-off ETM+ pixels are handled at the later pixel-level bridge gate.
A passing site need not enter the final ecological sample; this roster is only for measurement validation.
prohibited: choosing sites based on the eventual ETM+-OLI spectral discrepancy
stop_rule: Do not widen the date window, pairing tolerance, cloud threshold, or minimum pair counts after demographic outcomes or bridge discrepancies are observed.
